stories.title: Savarino sues NFTA over DL&W Terminal redevelopment
stories.summary: Savarino companies claim the NFTA improperly terminated their development agreement after years of work and at least $1.4 million in expenses.

stories.title: Police Departments including BPD explore use of drones as first responders
stories.summary: As drones become first responders in parts of the U.S., including Rochester, privacy and cost concerns surface alongside their potential to enhance policing.

stories.title: Bills CB Christian Benford donates $10,000 to provide Thanksgiving meals to Niagara Falls families
stories.summary: Buffalo Bills cornerback Christian Benford is helping bring Thanksgiving to families and individuals in need in Niagara Falls at Community Missions.

stories.title: Friends of Night People prepares for Thanksgiving as demand for meals grows
stories.summary: The organization serves more than 7,000 meals a month and is seeking food, clothing and financial donations ahead of its annual holiday lunch.

stories.title: Buffalo Zoo shares heartbreaking update after polar bear Luna gives birth to cub
stories.summary: The cub, named Nova, was the first polar bear born in the U.S. since 2022. She died just two days after birth.

stories.title: 2 Your Money: Applying for Medicaid
stories.summary: The attorneys at the Stamm law firm have advice for applying for Medicaid.

stories.title: 2 Your Money: Gifting
stories.summary: The attorneys want people to know that gifting cash to people can impact your ability to receive Medicaid benefits in a nursing home.

stories.title: Williamsville man sentenced to probation for possessing assault weapon after domestic incident
stories.summary: Thomas F. Sibick, 41, of Williamsville, sentenced to five years probation for weapon possession after domestic incident led police to discover firearms at his home.

stories.title: Buffalo man sentenced to prison for armed robbery and shooting at police officers
stories.summary: Dejuan L. Williams, 43, sentenced to 20 years to life for multiple charges, including attempted murder following an armed robbery in April.

stories.title: Nationwide emergency alert test to interrupt TV and radio programming Tuesday
stories.summary: FEMA will test the Emergency Alert System Tuesday afternoon, briefly interrupting radio and TV programming across the country.

stories.title: 3 residents, 3 firefighters hospitalized after fire breaks out on Scoville Ave in Buffalo
stories.summary: A house fire on Scoville Ave in Buffalo has led to three residents and three firefighters being hospitalized Monday evening.

stories.title: Megadeth coming to KeyBank Center in 2027
stories.summary: Metal legends Megadeth coming to KeyBank Center in 2027 as park of Outbreak: Vaccination of the Nations tour
